hints.title: Sorted Element Incrementation
hints.text: Sorting the collection reveals duplicates immediately. Each duplicate element must be incremented so it strictly exceeds its predecessor.

hints.title: Greedy Minimum Progression
hints.text: Iterate through the sorted numbers. If an element is less than or equal to the previous value, increase it to exactly previous plus one and tally the difference.

hints.title: Single Pass Difference Summation
hints.text: Sort nums in non-decreasing order. Maintain moves counter. For index i from 1 to n minus one, if nums[i] <= nums[i - 1], needed = nums[i - 1] + 1 - nums[i]. Add needed to moves and set nums[i] = nums[i - 1] + 1. Return moves.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly scanning for available unused integers takes quadratic time O(N^2), triggering Time Limit Exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array allows a single linear sweep to resolve all collisions in place with O(1) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that sorting guarantees that each element only needs to be compared against its immediate left neighbor.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(N + M) using count array where M is the maximum value.
